description: This is a Python module providing utilities for supporting multi-architecture compilation for ROCm in the PyTorch ecosystem. It includes functions to locate ROCm compiler tools, retrieve target architectures, compile LLVM IR to device code for specific architectures, bundle multiple device codes into a single multi-arch bundle, and orchestrate the entire compilation workflow.

methods.name: str get_rocm_compiler()
methods.description: Returns the path to ROCm's clang compiler, raising an error if ROCm is not properly configured.

methods.name: str get_rocm_bundler()
methods.description: Returns the path to clang-offload-bundler utility, raising an error if not found.

methods.name: list[str] get_rocm_target_archs()
methods.description: Retrieves the list of target architectures from environment variables, inductor config, or defaults to torch.cuda.get_arch_list.

methods.name: bool compile_llvm_ir_to_code_object( llvm_ir_path: str, output_path: str, target_arch: str )
methods.description: Compiles an LLVM IR (.ll) file into a device-specific code object (.hsaco) for a given architecture.

methods.name: bool create_multiarch_bundle(code_objects: dict, output_bundle_path: str)
methods.description: Creates a multi-architecture bundle integrating multiple device-specific code objects into a single binary.

methods.name: bool compile_multiarch_bundle_from_llvm_ir( llvm_ir_path: str, output_bundle_path: str, target_archs: Optional[list[str]] = None )
methods.description: Orchestrates the full workflow of compiling LLVM IR into multiple device-specific code objects and bundling them into a single multi-arch binary.

ctags.signature: ( llvm_ir_path: str, output_path: str, target_arch: str )
